about: High or critical npm audit advisories accepted after review (scripts/check-audit.mjs). Each needs a reason and a reviewBy date; the check fails once that date passes, so every exception is looked at again. Remove an entry once a release fixes it.

exceptions.reason: OAuth sign-in state accepted as a magic link token (account takeover). Only a Better Auth server with magic links and a social or Generic OAuth provider is affected. This app runs no Better Auth server: Neon's hosted Managed Better Auth does, and Neon's changelog of 2026-11-06 says it runs Better Auth 1.7.16 with this fixed, server-side in every region. Google sign-in (our own Google client) is on the testbed and development branches since 2026-11-14 on that basis. The bundled SDK (@neondatabase/auth 0.7.0-beta) still pins better-auth 1.7.6, which runs only as client code here; drop this exception when the SDK moves to 1.7.7 or later.

OAuth Proxy plugin trusts a forged profile. Needs the OAuth Proxy plugin and cookie-stored OAuth state on the Better Auth server; Neon Auth has no OAuth providers here and the app runs no Better Auth server. No fixed release exists yet.

Memory use when validating oversized constrained collections. Only the zod copy bundled inside @neondatabase/auth is affected; it validates responses from Neon Auth, and the app never validates its own input with zod. Fixed in zod 4.6.6, but the SDK pins an older release.
